cards.title: What shards buy
cards.text: Shards come from kills, chests and time survived. They buy mostly new options, few raw stats.
cards.why: You prefer upgrades that change how you play over +20% numbers. So most of this is more slots, more modules and more shapes.
cards.pick: These seven, in this order of importance.

parts.title: Slots
parts.text: +1 slot to a cast. Up to Weapon 6, Summon 5, Dash 4.

parts.title: Module pool
parts.text: Runs start with 14 of the 28 modules in chests. Some unlock by shards, some by doing (kill 300 burning enemies).

parts.title: Shapes
parts.text: Beam and Burst as starting weapons, and in chests.

parts.title: Start kit
parts.text: Begin a run with one module you've found before, at common.

parts.title: Rerolls and bans
parts.text: Reroll a level-up, or ban a module from showing up.

parts.title: A few vitals
parts.text: Small max HP and pickup range. Kept small on purpose.

cards.title: Practice room
cards.text: Unlock a practice room early: build anything from modules you've found, no slot limits, on dummies?
cards.why: This is where Wings-sized spells get made. A run caps a Weapon at 6 modules; here there's no cap. It's also where players learn the system.
cards.pick: Yes, after the first run, with spawnable enemies.

cards.title: Codex
cards.text: A codex page per module, showing it on all five shapes like the pictures in this pack?
cards.why: The five-shapes picture is the clearest way to teach that modules work everywhere.
cards.pick: Yes, filled in as you find them.

cards.title: Unlock by doing
cards.text: Some modules unlock by doing something, not by spending shards?
cards.why: It ties unlocks to how you play (earned, not bought). The risk is grinding a weird challenge.
cards.pick: Yes for about a third of them, with plain goals.
